prompt.text:
Implement an in-memory `TripLedger` and export it as `module.exports = { TripLedger }`. The constructor optionally accepts an array of trip records. Each record must contain a unique non-empty string `id`, a `mode` of `"walk"` or `"paddle"`, positive finite `distanceKm` and `durationMinutes`, and a non-empty `points` array of `{ lat, lon }` finite coordinates with latitude in [-90,90] and longitude in [-180,180]. Walks require positive finite `stepRate` and must not contain `currentKnots`; paddles require non-negative finite `currentKnots` and must not contain `stepRate`. Unknown fields are allowed but must not appear in returned records.

`add(record)` validates and stores a normalized copy, returning a copy. Duplicate IDs throw `RangeError`; malformed records throw `TypeError` or `RangeError`. `list()` returns independent copies in insertion order. `select(id)` returns an independent copy or `null`; a malformed ID throws `TypeError`. `remove(id)` returns whether a record was removed and preserves relative order. `toJSON()` returns a deterministic JSON string of the normalized record array. `TripLedger.fromJSON(text)` validates JSON and returns a new ledger; invalid JSON or a non-array root throws `TypeError`. Caller mutations and mutations of returned values must never affect stored state. An empty ledger is valid.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
